facts.fact: 本章视角人物是 Saskia：她听到 Lucy 尖叫，从自己家碗里抓了钥匙冲出门，上楼进 Lucy 公寓。
facts.anchor: Saskia plucks her key from the bowl and bolts outside.

facts.fact: Lucy 说半夜醒来有个男人在她地板上浑身是血，肚子被刺，抓住她并朝她脸上咳血，转头就不见了。
facts.anchor: I saw him lying on my floor covered in blood

facts.fact: Saskia 知道 Lucy 说的是什么——她自己也见过同样的东西，却对 Lucy 说那只是梦。
facts.anchor: Saskia knows exactly what she’s talking about.

facts.fact: Lucy 下楼锁前门、把门挡楔进门缝，Saskia 在床上等她，且不希望 Lucy 问她怎么进来的。
facts.anchor: She hurries downstairs to lock the front door and wedge in her doorstop

facts.fact: Saskia 编/讲自己的夜惊：门开一条缝，有个拿刀的老妇人站在那里，眼睛“饥饿”。
facts.anchor: there’s an old woman standing there with a knife

facts.fact: Saskia 比 Lucy 高半英尺，她把 Lucy 的脸转过来，两人鼻尖对鼻尖，她先吻了 Lucy。
facts.anchor: Saskia is half a foot taller, but now they are deliciously nose to nose

facts.fact: Saskia 把 Lucy 拉到自己身上，腾出双手，决定让 Lucy 忘掉她自以为看见的一切。
facts.anchor: Saskia rolls onto her back, pulling Lucy on top of her

facts.fact: 章末落点：Saskia 要用身体让 Lucy 只看见星星（性场面收束，无对话）。
facts.anchor: She will make Lucy see nothing but stars.
